title: Three Seasons and One Short Net
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：shore　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 shore 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the fisherman ① reached the shore that no boatman in the harbour would have recorded, and he said the reaching was the whole of the season. The ② shore, meaning the bank itself and not the net, ran three seasons and stayed unrecorded in the book; a shore, he said, is the only thing in a harbour that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ shore in that harbour had the same short net beside it, and the ④ shore at the far pier, meaning the catch they kept for the children to land and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A shore, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the fisherman said the recording is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the shore was the whole of the matter, meaning the homecoming and not the bank. The ⑥ shore, meaning the homecoming and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; shore, he said, is either something you reach or the only word that means both a bank and a homecoming. He said the homecoming is the part they remember.

By 1962 the ⑦ shore had become a line in a logbook, and the logbook had become an argument about the short net. The ⑧ shore of the whole thing, the fisherman wrote in July, was one harbour and three seasons of recording; shore, he said, is either the catch at the far pier or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ shore I remember is the bank recorded in the logbook, which closed in 1964 and is still recorded as the quietest in the harbour. A ⑩ shore, my mother said in 1966, is the only bank that improves by being recorded; every shore, she said, is a homecoming that has agreed to look like a bank. She said the homecoming was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 岸；滨（指渔港里每一段旁边的那一段）
B. n. 岸；滨（指那段岸本身，与小小的渔网相对）
C. 固定搭配：reach the shore 靠这一段岸
D. n. 岸；滨（指留给孩子们起的那一网）
E. n. 岸之事（抽象总称，指一处渔港的岸之事）
F. n. 岸；滨（指航海日志里写到、被记载的那一段）
G. n. 岸、归处（指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 归处（抽象总称，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: reached the shore that no boatman in the harbour would have recorded
The shore, meaning the bank itself and not the net
the shore at the far pier
the shore was the whole of the matter

A shore, my mother said in 1966

answers.why: reach the shore 意为“靠这一段岸”，1957 年那位渔人把渔港里没有一位船工肯记载的一段岸做了一遍。
shore 意为“岸；滨”，指那段岸本身而不是小小的渔网，它经过了三个汛期而在簿子上没有被记载。
shore 意为“岸；滨”，指渔港里每一段旁边的那一段，每一段旁边都有同一张小小的渔网。
shore 意为“岸；滨”，指最远那座码头的留给孩子们起的那一网，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
shore 意为“岸、归处”，指一件事里人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这段归处就是那件事的全部。
shore 意为“归处”，指人人都捕却无人提起的那样东西而不是那段岸，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
shore 意为“岸；滨”，指航海日志里写到、被记载的那一段，到 1962 年这一段成了航海日志里的一行。
shore 意为“岸之事”，渔人七月写道，整件事的岸之事是一处渔港和三个汛期的记载。
shore 意为“岸；滨”，我记得的是航海日志里记载过的那一段，1964 年归港了，至今仍被说成渔港里最安静的一段。
shore 为抽象总称，母亲 1966 年说，岸是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的岸。
